Model = NOCK widget MODEL_HAMMER fetched from IDUNA's new public /api/v1/shankpit-models route (cached on disk; built-in fallback), drawn in 1st and 3rd person via held_model.h (axis/heavy-end/scale normalised). MAX_WEAPONS 8->9. make test-hammer, test-held-model, test-brick-world hammer scenario. (sess-20260923-1030-4a526255)
